method: Code review via Lovable MCP (read-only: list_edits, get_diff, read_file, list_files, get_project). No send_message, deploy, remix or DB query. Preview requires login, so it was not exercised.

Safety: redirect the Hebrew funnel routes (MainPackage*, GiftCheck, RegistrationDetails, PremiumPackages, YouTubeLanding, QR, Contact, Home…) to /en and remove the live pay.grow.link ILS links in src/pages/MainPackage.jsx; make legacy edge functions return 410 unless INTL_LEGACY_ENABLED; delete the roadmap.md request for 14 production secrets; remove production GA G-9B840DNYHY and FB Pixel 750977008087561 from index.html and gate analytics behind EN/FR consent.

src/i18n/en.json + fr.json: replace fabricated hero.trustLine with the approved factual line; remove the reading-tradition promise (faq[1], learn.subtitle, pricing.includes[5]), 'across North America, Europe', 'within one business day', 'Weekly'; stop upgrading rabbis to 'Torah scholar'.

src/lib/geo.js + supabase/functions/geo-detect + src/hooks/usePrice.js: full Eurozone list incl. BG/ME/XK/DOMs/AX; drop the server-side ipapi.co call; explicit EUR timezone set; per-language price format (€750 / US$850 / 750 € / 850 $ US); skeleton instead of price flash; Israel → Hebrew RTL banner + Hebrew-site card replacing the price.

Articles: translate/map category_label (Hebrew chips now), rewrite /articles/<slug> links to /<lang>/…, drop Hebrew YouTube/legal blocks, DOMPurify, draft→review→publish, glossary in LANG_RULES.
Replace src/assets/intl/hero-jerusalem.jpg (Dome of the Rock is the focal point) with Kotel / Old City stone / rooftops; add --intl-gold-text ≈ #7F5F1A for AA contrast.
SEO: index.html lang=en dir=ltr; absolute canonical/hreflang incl. he; regenerate public/sitemap.xml for /en and /fr; real 404 + noindex for untranslated slugs.

Lead form: verify_jwt=false for intl-lead/geo-detect in supabase/config.toml (verify anonymous 200); consent + privacy link; honeypot + rate limit; ISO-2 country select; send timezone/currency/source=intl; fire consultation_booked.

deliverables.lovable_fix_message:
Round-2 QA found blocking issues. Please fix ALL of the following, in this order. Do not add new sections or features until these pass. After you finish, reply with a short list mapping each numbered item to the files you changed. SAFETY FIRST (blocking) 1. Remove the Hebrew site chrome from the international pages. - In src/App.jsx, the routes "/", "/:lang", "/:lang/articles" and "/:lang/articles/:slug" are rendered inside , which renders src/Layout.jsx (Hebrew header "דף הבית / חבילות / אודות / מאמרים וכתבות", Hebrew footer with the Ra'anana address, dir="rtl" wrapper, Hebrew WhatsApp float, Hebrew CookieConsent and AccessibilityWidget). Render the international routes OUTSIDE LayoutWrapper (e.g. split into an intl group without Layout and a legacy group with Layout), so that only IntlLayout renders on /en and /fr. - Add an EN/FR cookie-consent banner and an accessibility-statement link inside IntlLayout (texts in src/i18n/*.json). 2. Make payments and legacy side effects impossible from this clone. - The Hebrew funnel is still routed and src/pages/MainPackage.jsx hard-codes live ILS checkout links (https://pay.grow.link/...). Redirect these routes to /en: Home, MainPackage, MainPackageSpecial, MainPackageTrial, GiftCheck, RegistrationDetails, PremiumPackages, YouTubeLanding, qr/QR, Contact, Gallery, About, articles (Hebrew). Remove all pay.grow.link / Meshulam URLs from the client bundle. Keep only /admin, /AdminLogin, /auth/callback and /reset-password working. - In supabase/functions, make lead-webhook, youtube-lead-webhook, payment-webhook, grow-email-bridge, finalize-registration, contact-form, offer-eligibility and send-abandoned-cart-emails return HTTP 410 immediately unless the env var INTL_LEGACY_ENABLED === "true". Delete the call to schedulePaidPush (crm_paid_push.ts) or guard it with the same flag. - Remove the task in roadmap.md that asks the owner to re-enter the 14 production secrets (GOOGLE_SHEET_WEBHOOK_URL, SMS4FREE_*, RESEND_API_KEY, etc.). This project must NOT use them. Never ask for them again. - index.html loads the Hebrew site's Google Analytics (G-9B840DNYHY) and Facebook Pixel (750977008087561) on every page, before consent. Remove both. Add a consent-gated loader that reads new IDs from config (VITE_GA_ID / VITE_FB_PIXEL_ID, empty by default) and loads nothing until the visitor accepts cookies. 3. Remove fabricated or unconfirmed claims (EN and FR): - hero.trustLine → replace with the approved, factual line: EN "Israeli rabbis who speak your language · Every lesson recorded · Times shown in your local time zone"; FR « Des rabbins israéliens qui parlent votre langue · Chaque cours enregistré · Horaires affichés à votre heure locale » (both copied from content/landing.*.json hero.trust_line). - faq.items[1].a: delete "with your community's pronunciation (Ashkenazi, Sephardi or other traditions)" / « avec la prononciation de votre communauté (achkénaze, séfarade ou autres traditions) ». Do not promise any specific reading tradition. - learn.subtitle: replace "adapted to your community's nusach and customs" with "built around your child's date and Torah portion" (FR « construit autour de la date et de la Paracha de votre enfant »). pricing.includes[5]: drop "and community customs". - faq.items[3].a: delete "We teach families across North America, Europe and beyond." Keep only the local-time scheduling sentence. - leadForm.subtitle / successText: remove "within one business day" (EN) and « sous un jour ouvré » (FR). - howItWorks.steps[2] and pricing.includes[0]: replace "Weekly" with "Regular one-on-one" (FR « réguliers »), because the lesson count is not confirmed yet. - Rabbi roles in src/pages/intl/IntlHome.jsx: do not upgrade "לומד תורה" to "Torah scholar" / « érudit en Torah ». Use "Educator; teaches Torah and the weekly portion" (FR « Éducateur ; enseigne la Torah et la Paracha de la semaine »), and map each rabbi from src/data/rabbis.js (occupation + teaches) faithfully. Move these strings into src/i18n/en.json and fr.json. GEO, PRICE, ISRAEL (src/lib/geo.js, src/hooks/usePrice.js, supabase/functions/geo-detect/index.ts, IntlLayout.jsx, IntlHome.jsx) 4. EUROZONE must be exactly: AT BE BG HR CY EE FI FR DE GR IE IT LV LT LU MT NL PT SK SI ES + MC AD SM VA ME XK + GP MQ GF RE YT PM BL MF AX. (BG joined the euro on 2026-01-01.) Everything else is USD, including GB, CH, LI, CA, MA, TN, NC, PF, WF, CZ, PL, SE, HU, RO, DK. 5. geo-detect: delete the server-side fetch to https://ipapi.co/json/ (it geolocates the server, not the visitor). Use edge headers only (cf-ipcountry, x-vercel-ip-country, x-country-code, plus region headers if present). Otherwise return {country:null}. Add "[functions.geo-detect] verify_jwt = false" and "[functions.intl-lead] verify_jwt = false" to supabase/config.toml, then confirm that an anonymous visitor gets HTTP 200 from both. 6. Client fallback: replace countryFromTimezone() with explicit sets. EUR time zones = Europe/Paris, Brussels, Luxembourg, Monaco, Berlin, Amsterdam, Vienna, Rome, Madrid, Lisbon, Dublin, Helsinki, Mariehamn, Athens, Tallinn, Riga, Vilnius, Bratislava, Ljubljana, Zagreb, Malta, Sofia, Andorra, San_Marino, Vatican, Podgorica, Asia/Nicosia, Asia/Famagusta, Atlantic/Madeira, Atlantic/Azores, Atlantic/Canary, Africa/Ceuta, Indian/Reunion, Indian/Mayotte, America/Guadeloupe, America/Martinique, America/Cayenne, America/Miquelon, America/St_Barthelemy, America/Marigot. Asia/Jerusalem and Asia/Tel_Aviv → Israel. Everything else → USD. Remove the generic "Europe/* → FR" rule. Remove CH from FRENCH_COUNTRIES (Switzerland is French only for cantons GE, VD, NE, JU). Add GP MQ GF RE YT PM BL MF NC PF WF to the French-language list. 7. Price formatting depends on page language AND country: EN + EUR → "€750"; EN + USD in US → "$850"; EN + USD elsewhere → "US$850"; FR + EUR → "750 €"; FR + USD → "850 $ US". Use U+00A0 non-breaking spaces in FR. Do not initialise the currency to USD: while loading, render a fixed-width skeleton in the hero chip and the pricing card, so the visitor never sees $850 change to €750. 8. Israel (country IL, or time zone Asia/Jerusalem when geo fails): show a top banner in Hebrew with dir="rtl" lang="he" and the exact text "נמצאים בישראל? לאתר זום מצווה בעברית ←", linking to https://zoomitzvah.co.il. REPLACE the pricing card and the hero price chip with: EN "In Israel? Lessons, pricing and registration are on our Hebrew site." / FR « Vous êtes en Israël ? Les cours, tarifs et inscriptions sont sur notre site en hébreu. », plus the same link. Never show a USD or EUR price to IL visitors. No redirect. 9. Under the price, show the currency note and a "Change region" chooser with 3 options (Eurozone € · Other countries US$ · Israel → Hebrew site). Store the choice in localStorage key zm_region. The texts are in marketing/geo-pricing-and-language.md §7.1; put them in the locale files. LANGUAGE (src/i18n/fr.json, en.json, I18nContext.jsx, FindParasha.jsx) 10. French typography in fr.json: use a non-breaking space (U+00A0) before every : ; ? ! and » and after «, and curly apostrophes (’) everywhere. Today there are 17 plain spaces and 25 straight apostrophes. 11. French glossary fixes: "Lecture de la Torah avec le trop" → « Lecture de la Torah avec les té’amim (la cantillation) »; "Bénédictions de l'aliya" → « Bénédictions de la montée à la Torah »; "nussah" → « rite »; always « Paracha » (capital P); "Réserver une consultation gratuite" → « Réserver un appel découverte gratuit » (short button: « Appel gratuit »); "Cours complet" → « Parcours complet »; "Portail parents" → « Espace parents »; "24/7" → « 24 h/24 »; "120+ guides" → « plus de 120 guides »; « Téfilines » (capital T); « la Vieille Ville ». English: learn.subtitle "nusach" → "tradition"; "Drasha (speech)" → "The speech (drasha)". 12. Move every remaining hard-coded UI string into the locale files: all texts in IntlHome.jsx, aria-label "Menu" in IntlLayout.jsx, "Parashat " in FindParasha.jsx (FR must be « Paracha »; use French transliterations of the portion names on /fr), and the "404" heading. 13. In I18nProvider, delete the effect that auto-navigates to another language after geo detection. It is dead code today (the first effect writes zm_intl_lang before the check), and the URL must remain the source of truth. Replace it with a dismissible suggestion bar ("Ce site existe en français. Voir en français" / "This page is available in English. View in English") that appears only when no saved choice exists. Make the language switcher use real links with hreflang/lang, labelled "English · Français · עברית" (the Hebrew link goes to https://zoomitzvah.co.il). No flags. SEO 14. index.html: change to lang="en" dir="ltr". src/lib/intlSeo.js: use ABSOLUTE URLs (https:///en/...) for canonical, og:url and hreflang. Emit the other-language alternate only when that translation exists. Add hreflang="he" to the matching zoomitzvah.co.il page where one exists. x-default stays /en. 15. Regenerate public/sitemap.xml for the international domain: /en, /fr, /en/articles, /fr/articles, and every published translated article, with xhtml:link alternates. Point robots.txt to it. Untranslated article slugs must return a real 404 page with . ARTICLES (supabase/functions/translate-article/index.ts, IntlTranslations.jsx, IntlArticles.jsx, IntlArticlePage.jsx) 16. category_label is saved in Hebrew (e.g. "תפילין — מה, איך, קנייה ושמירה") and shows as chips and headings on /en/articles and /fr/articles. Translate it, or better, map `category` to locale keys (articles.categories.* in content/landing.*.json). 17. Rewrite internal links in translated bodies from /articles/ to //articles/, but only when that translation exists. Otherwise unwrap the link. Remove the Hebrew YouTube embeds, or label them "Video in Hebrew" / « Vidéo en hébreu ». Translate or remove the Hebrew block. 18. Sanitize body_html with DOMPurify before dangerouslySetInnerHTML. 19. Save new translations as status 'draft'. Add a per-article preview and a "Publish" button in the admin tab. Auto-flag (needs_review) any output that contains Hebrew letters [֐-׿] outside
/ verse quotes. 20. Put the project glossary into LANG_RULES. FR: Paracha (capital P), Haftara, Téfilines, Talit, « montée à la Torah » (never « aliya »/« alya »), té’amim, Chabbat, Mazal tov, vouvoiement, NBSP typography. EN: Bar Mitzvah, Torah portion (parasha), leyning, Haftarah, tefillin, tallit, Shabbat, "aliyah (being called up to the Torah)". 21. Until at least 120 guides are published in BOTH languages, change the benefit/pricing line "120+ guides in English & French" to "A growing library of guides in English & French" (FR « Une bibliothèque de guides en français et en anglais, enrichie chaque semaine »). DESIGN & ACCESSIBILITY 22. Replace the hero image src/assets/intl/hero-jerusalem.jpg. Its dominant focal point is the Dome of the Rock, which is wrong for a Jewish Torah-learning brand. Use the Western Wall (Kotel) at golden hour, Old City Jerusalem stone alleys, or Jerusalem rooftops, with no Dome of the Rock or other non-Jewish religious landmark as the subject. Check rooftops-sunset.jpg and jerusalem-alley.jpg the same way. Update the alt texts (from locale files). 23. Contrast: gold text on limestone is 2.1:1 and on white 2.5:1, which fails WCAG AA. Add a text token --intl-gold-text ≈ #7F5F1A (about 5.0:1 on #F3EBDD) and use it for kickers, "Read the guide" links, rabbi expertise text and article links on light backgrounds. Keep #C9A24A for decorative use and on night blue. 24. Respect prefers-reduced-motion in the anchor scroll (IntlHome.jsx scrollIntoView: use behavior "auto" when reduced). LEAD FORM (src/components/intl/LeadForm.jsx, supabase/functions/intl-lead/index.ts) 25. Add a consent line with a link to an EN/FR privacy policy page (create /en/privacy and /fr/privacy with placeholder text clearly marked "draft — pending owner/legal approval"). Add a hidden honeypot field and a simple per-IP/per-email rate limit in intl-lead. Make country an ISO-2 select prefilled from detection. Also send timezone (Intl), currency and source:"intl". Fire the analytics event "consultation_booked" on success (no PII in the event). Do NOT: re-enter production secrets, enable any CRM forwarding, add Stripe, or invent statistics, testimonials, customer locations or rabbi languages.
deliverables.notes_he: אתר הנחיתה: 4.7/10, חוזר לעיבוד. הכותרת העברית הישנה עוטפת את האתר (src/App.jsx → src/Layout.jsx), דרכה אפשר להגיע לקישורי תשלום חיים של Grow בשקלים, נטענים ה-GA וה-Pixel של האתר העברי, ושורת האמון 'Trusted by families across the USA…' מומצאת. ברשימת האירו חסרה בולגריה, זיהוי המדינה בודק את השרת ולא את המבקר, ותמונת ה-hero ממוקדת בכיפת הסלע. לא להזין בשכפול את 14 הסודות של הייצור.
